## Workflow or problem

What are you trying to accomplish, and where does the current workflow stop?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected inputs, outputs and user-visible result.

## Runtime or model requirements

For an integration, include the source format, destination runtime, hardware and
an openly available minimal example when possible.

## Verification

How could we demonstrate real conversion, inference and numerical correctness?
Mention alternatives or workarounds you have tried.
